title: Top 5 STRANGEST Stars In The Universe
hook: Number one is spinning 700 times every single second.

items.name: Red Giant Betelgeuse
items.stat: So huge it would swallow Mars if placed at our Sun's center, about 700 times wider than the Sun.

items.name: White Dwarf Sirius B
items.stat: A dying star crushed to Earth's size, where a teaspoon of it weighs about 5 tons.

items.name: Magnetar
items.stat: Its magnetic field is a thousand trillion times stronger than Earth's, enough to erase a credit card from 100,000 miles away.

items.name: Hypergiant UY Scuti
items.stat: One of the largest known stars, roughly 1,700 times the Sun's radius.

items.name: Millisecond Pulsar
items.stat: This neutron star spins over 700 times per second, its surface racing at a quarter the speed of light.
